overarching_topic: Self-hosted, open-source "agent brains" — the persistent memory, knowledge, and context layers an agent owns locally instead of renting from a vendor — surveyed through concrete implementations (garrytan/gbrain, Letta/MemGPT, getnao/sylph, mem0, Zep, Cognee and peers) and the OKF/open-knowledge-format push toward a portable, file-based context layer agents can carry between tools.
